dict.string: RunJeet reads your daily step totals from Apple Health to show accurate activity even when the app is closed.
RunJeet may save workouts you choose to record.
RunJeet records your route and distance during activities you start.
RunJeet continues recording an activity you started when your iPhone screen is locked.
RunJeet needs background location access to continue an activity you started.
RunJeet uses motion activity to display your iPhone's pedometer step count.
